At least we got a podium. Our pace and consistency weren’t where we wanted it to be, lots to learn from.
Great to see so much support out here this weekend. Thank you Austin 🙌
detailZh:
至少我们获得了领奖台。我们的速度和稳定性并没有达到我们想要的水平，有很多东西可以学习。

detailEn:
At least we got a podium. Our pace and consistency weren’t where we wanted it to be, lots to learn from.
Great to see so much support out here this weekend. Thank you Austin 🙌
